blocks.text: This page tracks the Maple Ridge MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for September 2026: $882,600 for a typical home, down 7.0% over twelve months.
Maple Ridge benchmark prices and trends, September 2026

A typical Maple Ridge home carried an MLS® Home Price Index benchmark of $882,600 in September 2026. That is little changed at −0.9% on the month, down 1.8% over three months, down 4.1% over six months and down 7.0% over the year. Over three years it is down 11.8%, and over five years down 4.5%.
The weakest one-year move in Maple Ridge was for a townhouse homes at −8.1%; the strongest was an apartment at −2.6%.
The gap between a detached home ($1,155,900) and an apartment ($513,400) is $642,500, and a townhouse ($700,800) sits $187,400 above the apartment benchmark.
Against Greater Vancouver, where the all-home benchmark was $1,075,900, Maple Ridge is 18.0% below. Over the year Greater Vancouver moved down 5.5% against down 7.0% here.
Of the 20 areas this board reports, Maple Ridge ranks 15 by all-home benchmark, with Coquitlam above it at $971,700 and Burnaby North below it at $877,100.

Detached homes in Maple Ridge: benchmark $1,155,900, down 1.9% in a month, down 2.9% in three months, down 5.6% in six months, down 7.7% in a year, down 10.6% in three years and down 3.3% in five. That is 35.2% below the detached benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($1,784,700).

Townhouse homes in Maple Ridge: benchmark $700,800, little changed at −0.5% in a month, down 3.8% in three months, down 4.3% in six months, down 8.1% in a year, down 9.8% in three years and little changed at −0.1% in five. That is 31.1% below the townhouse benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($1,016,700).

Apartment homes in Maple Ridge: benchmark $513,400, up 1.8% in a month, up 2.9% in three months, little changed at −0.1% in six months, down 2.6% in a year, down 9.5% in three years and up 8.2% in five. That is 24.8% below the apartment benchmark for Greater Vancouver ($682,500).

blocks.text: What the Maple Ridge figure is
The $882,600 Maple Ridge figure is a modelled price for a typical home, not a median, and it comes from Greater Vancouver REALTORS® for September 2026.
